upstream_compiler_sources.key_identity: Official Rust Forge signing-key link and independent Keybase Rust key returned the same public bytes/fingerprint. Both original archives passed isolated GPG verification and exact embedded git-commit-hash/version witnesses.

metadata_probe.conditions: Native AMD64 Cargo metadata --offline --locked with original patched workspaces mounted read-only and checksum-derived vendor tree. No build script, compilation or target execution. Both origins/targets passed; locks unchanged.

signed_arm64_elf_embedded_registry_root_.scope: Observed paths all match collected crate archives. Absence of a string is not absence of code; this does not prove complete static linkage or exact compiled features.

regression_tests.dangerous_mutant: Bypassing the archive SHA256 check makes the real changed-archive regression fail with DID NOT RAISE InputError.

scope: Exact registry archive/member inputs and independently release-signed upstream compiler/standard-library sources only, verified on AMD64 without ARM execution. Conservative Cargo metadata and observed ELF strings are not complete target-linkage proofs. Supplemental original Alpine build logs were retrieved, but are not signed build attestations and are not used as an authentication bypass. Distro compiler patch/build provenance, complete nested-source attribution, final image delivery/consumer, aggregate source gate and advisory/MCP acceptance remain required.
